title: Brazilian Digital Identity on Instagram — Code and Thematic Corpus
description: Research code and anonymized thematic corpus (17,287 Instagram comments) for the study of Brazilian digital identity. Three cases: Bruno Mars (8,100), Fernanda Torres / Oscar 2025 (6,619), Cristiano Ronaldo tribute to Pelé (2,568). Multi-label themes C1–C5 + character (Afetivo/Cognitivo) + tone (Positivo/Negativo/Neutro). Pipeline: deterministic rules (69% coverage) + dual LLM coders (gpt-5-nano) with reviewer adjudication (gpt-5-mini) and residual human review (kappa gate max<0.80). Data collected March 7–11, 2026; anonymized @handle→@user. See classification/METHODOLOGY.md and Hugging Face dataset.
